if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vst3sdk/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Steinberg VST3 SDK not found in external/vst3sdk")
endif()
set(SMTG_ENABLE_VST3_PLUGIN_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SMTG_ENABLE_VST3_HOSTING_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SMTG_ENABLE_VSTGUI_SUPPORT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(vst3sdk_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vst3sdk" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(vst3sdk)
